scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name radio --branch master
scripts.cloudflare:dev: cd api && npx --yes wrangler pages dev ../dist --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.cloudflare:db:migrate:local: cd api && npx --yes wrangler d1 migrations apply radio-production --local --persist-to .wrangler/state
